label: Stage-one arrivals use the Euclidean premise only at the selected world
summary: Usage map: in both stage-one arrivals the global Euclidean premise is used only at the selected world w, as hEuclidean w v w (with ActualReflexive at w, to bring v back to w) and hEuclidean w v z (to reach every successor z of w): Results/Causality/InertEmptiness/Solution.lean necessaryConcrete (lines 56-57) and Results/Causality/LocalFramePossibleExternalCause/Solution.lean sameCause (lines 28-29); the same pattern is NonlimitingConcreteExistence.necessaryAtOrigin (lines 51-52). Outside the two arrivals, EmptyHistoryCausalAvailability.lean line 89 uses Euclidean access at a non-selected world v (hEuclidean v w u), so that route is not covered by this weakening. earlierNecessary, necessaryOfExternalCandidate and ExternalCandidateNecessity.checks take no frame premise. New Euclidean-at-the-selected-world premise (ActualEuclidean.EuclideanAt) with strength result euclideanAtOfEuclidean; both arrivals re-proved from it (inertNecessaryConcrete, externalNecessaryConcrete) by composing earlierNecessary and necessaryOfExternalCandidate. Control.clustered is Euclidean and reflexive at actual but not Euclidean, and carries a history on which presence-to-existence, inert emptiness and the possible contingent-free past hold: the weakening is strict and not vacuous for the inert-emptiness arrival. No joint model of the full possible-external-cause bundle on that frame was built. The existing stepwise rival frame fails the restricted premise at actual, so it remains a countermodel to the restricted premise's omission. Even weaker sufficient condition, not registered: for the single witness v supplied by the possibility premise, v accesses w and every successor of w. Warrant under the alethic reading remains OPEN: it is the actual-world instance of S5, and a non-transitive possibility view (Salmon-style origin essentialism) that rejects global Euclideanness can still reject it at the actual world whenever two possibilities of the actual world differ in origin by more than the tolerance; the restriction removes only commitments about merely possible worlds' further possibilities.
